about:
Analog Devices Inc. is headquartered in Austin, Texas, and was founded in 1965. The company operates as a semiconductor manufacturer with a significant U.S. presence, including design and operations in Texas.

The company designs and manufactures analog integrated circuits, mixed-signal processors, and data converters. With a workforce exceeding 10,000 employees, Analog Devices operates at a large scale, serving global markets with a broad portfolio of semiconductor solutions.

Analog Devices serves the industrial, healthcare, and automotive sectors, providing components for instrumentation, industrial automation, medical devices, and automotive electronics.

The company's focus on analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing technologies underpins its product development, targeting high-performance applications in demanding environments.

old_description: At Anchor Ingredients, we are the trusted link from the farm to finished foods, providing ultimate connectivity throughout the entire supply chain. With exceptional products, a relentless attention to detail and proactive customer support, we’re committed to ensuring your brand’s success.
about:
Anchor Ingredients is headquartered in Fargo, North Dakota. The privately owned company operates offices, manufacturing facilities, and warehouses across the United States.

The company functions as a specialty ingredient supplier and contract manufacturer, offering farm-level sourcing partnerships, custom processing, freeze-dry co-manufacturing, blending, distribution, and logistics management. Its facilities employ advanced technologies for processing and quality assurance, supported by a supplier approval program and in-house testing validated by third parties.

Anchor Ingredients serves the pet food and human food industries, providing conventional and organic ingredients to brands seeking traceable supply chains. Customers include food manufacturers looking for end-to-end connectivity from farm to finished product.

Founded on a mission to cultivate connectivity and quality across the food supply chain, the company emphasizes transparency, traceability, and a customer-centric approach. Its AnchorCONNECT portal gives clients real-time access to certificates of analysis, bills of lading, and traceability reports for every order.

name: Anco Equipment
old_description: I have been in the food & dairy processing equipment industry for over 17 years and founded Anco Equipment almost 13 years ago. I take pride seeing my customers business grow using my equipment. When I am not working you can find me at the golf course, in the woods, or hanging out with my wife on our hobby farm.
about:
Anco Equipment is based in Pulaski, Wisconsin. The company was founded almost 13 years ago by Trevor Anderson, who brought 17 years of experience in the food and dairy processing equipment industry. His wife, Rebecca Anderson, joined as co-owner, having grown up in the dairy equipment business through her father, Fran Ullmer. The couple started the business to supply stainless steel processing equipment to food and dairy manufacturers.

Anco manufactures a range of stainless steel processing equipment, including process tanks, mixing tanks, milk silos, pasteurizers, homogenizers, cheese vats, butter churns, and COP wash tanks. The equipment is fabricated from 304 and 316 stainless steel and designed for heating, cooling, storing, mixing, and aging products in sterile environments. The company collaborates with experienced engineers to provide start-to-finish solutions, and its customer roster includes major brands such as Coca-Cola, Starbucks, Unilever, Godiva Chocolate, and McDonald's.

The company serves the food, dairy, beverage, cosmetic, and chemical industries. Its equipment is used by large-scale producers as well as smaller processors needing sanitary stainless steel systems. Anco's product line covers accessories, all-in-one factory systems, and specialized units like dome-top and wing-top pasteurizers.

Trevor Anderson founded Anco to help customers grow their businesses through reliable, detail-oriented equipment. The company emphasizes a pragmatic approach, attention to detail, and collaboration with seasoned engineers to deliver solutions that meet strict sanitary standards.

name: Anderson Woodwork's LLC furniture & cabinet,s
old_description: and build custom furniture, collector pieces, and studio line furniture for homeowners, collectors, and designers who want something real—furniture with presence, intention, and longevity. Every piece that leaves my shop is made by hand, using traditional joinery and carefully selected hardwoods, right here in Washington State.
about:
Anderson Woodworks LLC operates from a shop in Yelm, Washington, where founder Brian Anderson builds custom furniture, cabinetry, and one-of-a-kind collector pieces. An Olympia-area native, Anderson spent roughly twelve years in custom home building before opening his own shop, applying that experience to pieces that must live in real houses. The business is structured as an LLC with Anderson as the sole craftsman; every piece passes through his hands alone.

The shop produces dining tables, desks, consoles, kitchen and bath cabinetry, library built-ins, and closet systems, all using hand-cut dovetail and mortise-and-tenon joinery rather than screws or staples. Anderson also offers a Studio Line of proven designs built to order and a Collector Line of singular works that may include marquetry inlay and experimental forms. In addition to fabrication, he provides furniture-led interior design consultations—space planning, material direction, and layout guidance—charging fees for design direction and full-room design packages. Projects begin with a free on-site estimate in Thurston and Pierce Counties, followed by a paid design phase before any wood is cut.

Clients include homeowners, collectors, and interior designers throughout the South Sound region—Olympia, Lacey, Tumwater, Tacoma, and Gig Harbor—with collector pieces shipped nationally. The service model skips catalogs and middlemen; Anderson designs, builds, and delivers each piece, while installation is coordinated with the client’s contractor.

Anderson positions the business on the premise that furniture should shape the room, not follow trends. He emphasizes traditional joinery that takes longer but yields pieces intended to last generations, and he frames his role as helping clients make clear, confident decisions so their homes feel grounded and intentional.

name: Anglims Western Metalworks Inc
old_description: was started in 1981 as family-owned business founded by Clyde and Sandy Buckelew. Beginning as a one-man shop operating out of a garage, it grew and expanded to take on a wider variety of clients and jobs…
about:
Anglims Western Metalworks Inc operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The business was founded in 1981 by Clyde and Sandy Buckelew as a family-owned venture that began in a garage as a one-man shop. In 2010 the Buckelews retired and sold the company to Kevin and Jennifer Anglim, who had previously run a mobile welding and fabrication business.

The shop provides metal fabrication, welding, and precision cutting services. Core processes include fabrication in steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and sheet metal; MIG, TIG, and stick welding; 5-axis waterjet cutting on a Maxiem 1530 (OMAX) system; CNC cutting and shearing; machining; tube forming; and metal sign production. Work is performed in-house, with on-site fabrication and welding available for projects that cannot be transported. The waterjet offers a 10'0" x 5'2" cutting envelope and holds linear positional accuracy of ±0.0030" and repeatability of ±0.0010".

Customers span agriculture, clean-room technology, government and public utilities, healthcare, manufacturing, mining, restaurants, and facility support. Corporate and institutional clients have included PNM, the General Electric Airplane Engine Plant, Motorola, Intel, Rio Grande Concrete Plant, Sandia National Laboratories, and New Mexico Air Force bases, as well as local farmers and dairymen.

The company emphasizes attention to detail, precise craftsmanship, fairness, and customer service. It states that quality welds should be stronger than the base metal and visually seamless, a standard met through experienced welders and investment in equipment.

name: Ango Electronics Corporation
old_description: Since 2005, AnTek has been dedicated to providing reliable products, competitive prices, and exceptional service — supporting everyone from hobbyists to large-scale manufacturers with dependable power solutions.
about:
AnTek Inc. was established in 2005 in North Arlington, New Jersey, minutes from New York City. The company operates under the AnTek Products Corp. name and focuses on power solutions for a broad customer base.

The company designs and manufactures toroidal transformers for audio and CNC applications, with a product range spanning 10 VA to 4 kVA. It also produces tube amplifier power transformers, single-ended and push-pull output transformers, steel powder-coated amplifier chassis, and a line of unregulated power supplies rated from 50 W to over 1,000 W. Additional offerings include soft-start modules, rectifier and regulator modules, and tube amplifier kits.

AnTek serves customers from hobbyist DIY builders to professional audio and electronics manufacturers. Its transformers and power supplies are used in audio equipment, CNC machinery, and industrial automation systems powering solenoids, relays, DC motors, stepper motors, servo drives, DC-DC converters, and battery chargers.

AnTek emphasizes reliable products, competitive pricing, and exceptional service. It offers a customer satisfaction guarantee and automatic bulk discounts at checkout for large orders.

about:
Apollo Electric was founded in 1995 by George Wasilewski in New York City. After moving from Poland, Wasilewski established the firm as a small residential electrical business, building a reputation for precision and trust in one of the world’s most competitive markets. The company remains headquartered in New York, with satellite offices in Florida, Connecticut, California (operating as AE Electric), Texas, and Nevada.

The firm provides high-end electrical contracting for luxury single-family homes and commercial projects, including installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical panels, lighting, wiring, and outlets. Its teams also integrate customized lighting, audio-visual systems, Lutron HomeWorks controls, and EV charging infrastructure. A dedicated 24/7 service division in New York is staffed by licensed master electricians. In-house accounting, coordination, and estimating departments support project execution across all phases.

Apollo Electric serves architects, developers, and general contractors on projects such as the Porsche Tower Residences and flagship stores for Gucci, Celine, Rolex, and Tiffany & Co., as well as hospitality venues including Four Seasons Restaurants, Carbone, and EATALY. Its commercial portfolio spans luxury retail, hospitality, office, healthcare, and multifamily construction across the continental U.S.

The company emphasizes technical excellence, discretion, and long-term relationships, values Wasilewski set at its founding. Its national reach is coordinated through local project managers and a traveling division, ensuring consistent standards on every job.

old_description: Appalachian Supply Inc. established in 1982 in Littleton, NH, is a family owned plumbing, heating and electrical supply warehouse and hardware store that caters to wholesale as well as retail customers. Within a year, Appalachian Supply opened a second hardware store in St. Johnsbury, VT, which has now become our main operation. With nine employees and over 100 years of combined experience, Appalachian Supply continues to serve the Northeast Kingdom of Vermont and Northern New Hampshire.
about:
Appalachian Supply Inc. traces its roots to 1982 in Littleton, New Hampshire, where it began as a family-owned plumbing, heating, and electrical supply warehouse with an attached hardware store. Within a year the company opened a second location in St. Johnsbury, Vermont, which eventually became its primary operation. The business remains family-owned and is run by a team of nine employees who collectively hold more than a century of industry experience.

The company stocks and distributes a broad range of plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies, serving both wholesale and retail customers from its St. Johnsbury facility. In addition to product distribution, Appalachian Supply offers heating system design services and specializes in radiant heating solutions. Free quotes are provided for projects of any size.

Customers include contractors, builders, and homeowners across the Northeast Kingdom of Vermont and northern New Hampshire. The wholesale side supports trade professionals on job sites, while the retail hardware store serves walk-in consumers needing immediate parts or tools.

The company's guiding principle is captured in its slogan: "If We Can't Get It — You Don't Need It." This reflects a commitment to deep inventory availability and sourcing capability, particularly in radiant heating systems, which the firm identifies as its specialty.
